description: Run the same prompt through N LLM providers side-by-side. Each provider's response is a first-class Dagster asset with cost, latency, and token metadata — so 'should we go local' becomes an empirical asset-history query in Insights instead of a benchmarking spreadsheet.

outputs.description: One asset per provider (`{prefix}_{alias}`) containing response text + cost/latency/token metadata.

asset_name_prefix.label: Asset Name Prefix
asset_name_prefix.description: Prefix for the emitted assets. Each provider produces `{prefix}_{alias}`.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.description: Prompt source. Shapes: {kind: literal, text: '...'} | {kind: file, path: '...'} | {kind: url, url: '...'}. All string fields are {partition_key}-templated.

providers.label: Providers
providers.description: LLM providers to compare. Each: {alias, model, [api_key_env_var, api_base_env_var, system_prompt, temperature, max_tokens, cost_per_1k_tokens_override]}. alias becomes the asset name suffix. model is LiteLLM-compatible (gpt-4o-mini, claude-3-5-haiku-latest, ollama/qwen2.5:14b, openai/<hf-model> for vLLM / LM Studio / TGI).

system_prompt.label: System Prompt
system_prompt.description: Default system prompt applied to any provider that doesn't set its own.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Additional tags on the emitted assets.

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Partition type. Pair with a per-prompt dataset for scale demos.

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: ISO start date for daily partitions.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated string OR list for static partitioning.

dynamic_partition_name.label: Dynamic Partition Name
dynamic_partition_name.description: Name for the DynamicPartitionsDefinition when partition_type='dynamic'.

name: Inference Provider A/B Test
